name: plus-menu
title: Plus menu
description: A + that grows into the menu it opens. Pass it items with a label, hint, icon and onSelect.
docs:
Plus menu needs these transitions.dev snippets in the app:

  npx transitions-dev add plus-menu-morph

Load obvious's primitives and a theme first, then the transitions.dev CSS, then obvious/css/transitions-bridge.css, so the colours come from the theme.
